text:
sam-sales: Heads-up — BlueHarbor (enterprise fintech) is evaluating a migration from CloudPrompt to Redwood. They want a short POC (2-3 weeks), answers to a security questionnaire, and a pricing delta for heavy embedding + chat usage. Who can lead the tech presales side?
anya-presales: I can own coordination. Need eng + security to confirm feasibility and any blocking quotas. Can we map the CloudPrompt API surface they use?
raj-eng: Ping me. Quick question: are they using sessions/stateful chat or stateless single-shot generation? That affects KV cache and token billing.
lena-solutions: From initial docs: mostly chat with session IDs + long context (up to 16k tokens). They also use CloudPrompt's reranking endpoint for search results.
raj-eng: OK — long-context chat means we should propose Redwood Dedicated or Private with KV caching + quantized model to hit latency SLOs. Also need to flag prompt-parity risks: tokenization and stopping behavior differ.
kim-security: I can take the security questionnaire. Send it over and I'll run through our answers for data residency, KMS, audit logs, and e-discovery. Any PCI/PII specifics from BlueHarbor?
san-sales: @kim-security they handle card metadata but say tokens are hashed/pseudonymized. They still require SOC2 + a bespoke encryption workflow.
kim-security: Noted. We'll propose KMS integration + HSM option in Private. I'll also include our standard data retention and deletion controls.
alice-sre: For the POC staging, we can provision a Dedicated pool in us-east-1. Deploy-bot: provisioning request queued.
deploy-bot: Staging pool request created: job id p-cc-9921. ETA ~ 4h.
raj-eng: For the integration checklist: 1) request/response mapping (headers, rate limits) 2) prompt mapping (stop tokens, system message semantics) 3) tokenization diff tests 4) reranker parity tests 5) billing projection.
lena-solutions: I'll draft a sample shim mapping. Quick example they can drop in to proxy CloudPrompt -> Redwood: 
```json
// CloudPrompt request (client)
{
  "model": "cp-chat-16k",
  "session_id": "1234",
  "messages": [{"role":"system","content":"..."},{"role":"user","content":"..."}],
  "rerank": true
}

// Redwood equivalent (proxy)
{
  "model": "redwood-chat-16k",
  "session": "1234",
  "input": [{"role":"system","text":"..."},{"role":"user","text":"..."}],
  "features": {"rerank": true, "kv_cache": true}
}
```
raj-eng: Also include a tokenization test harness: give both APIs same prompt sets and measure token counts + stop differences. We should surface delta per prompt and propose small prompt rewrites to reduce hallucination.
lena-solutions: On pricing: they want a conservative estimate for 50M input tokens / month (chat + embeddings + rerank). I'll run numbers for hosted vs dedicated vs private. Any pricing constraints from procurement?
sam-sales: Procurement needs a 12-month committed price with SLAs. They want fallback behavior if Dedicated saturates.
raj-eng: Recommend: Dedicated commit with autoscale burst to hosted as fallback. We'll document consistent model variants and fallback mapping. Note that fallback to hosted may change privacy posture — must show explicit contract.
kim-security: We'll need a clause about telemetry: what logs we keep, redaction, and who can access. I'll add those to the security answers.
alice-sre: For the POC plan timeline: Week 0: kickoff + network allowlist. Week 1: shim + tokenization tests. Week 2: latency/load tests + reranker parity. Week 3: security signoff + pricing finalize.
anya-presales: Great — I'll assemble a one-pager with owners and send to BlueHarbor. Action items: @raj-eng tech lead, @kim-security sec lead, @alice-sre infra lead, @lena-solutions pricing + shim.
sam-sales: Perfect. BlueHarbor asked whether response ordering or sampling seeds could cause differing outputs vs CloudPrompt. Short answer?
raj-eng: Short: yes, sampling/rng and temperature handling may cause small deltas. We'll include deterministic sampling guidance, set seed if supported, and include a compare-and-acceptance criteria for acceptable output variance.
lena-solutions: I'll add an acceptance checklist for the POC: 
- tokenization parity <= 5% delta
- reranker recall within 2%
- 95th percentile latency <= existing SLA
- documented fallback privacy implications

sam-sales: Thanks — thumbs up. I'll schedule an intro call with BlueHarbor for tomorrow.
anya-presales: Sending the one-pager and security questionnaire now.
kim-security: Got it, starting the SQ answers.
alice-sre: Provisioning complete: staging pool p-cc-9921 ready.
deploy-bot: Provision complete. SSH jump host: jump-us-east-1-42.redwood.internal
raj-eng: I'll start the tokenization harness. Ping me for access.
sam-sales: Excellent — will update the customer. :tada:
